prompt:
Redraw the ENTIRE visible character in one whole-character generation, source-first, as a transparent Japanese hand-drawn flat-color PV character layer. IMAGE 1 ORIGINAL PV is the sole authority for composition, head-to-shoulder/body proportions, head tilt, eye opening/gaze, mouth, both hand gestures, sleeves/costume, and original bottom/side crop. Match its character performance and overall figure placement closely while replacing the original red hairstyle with the gray-bob identity. No captions, pink background or source effects.

PRIORITY: retain IMAGE 1's original small head and cap relative to the shoulders and torso. The face belongs between the original cap and neckline, with the original chin level. Keep comfortable original space above the cap. The bob follows the original central skull, face and nape proportions; it does not enlarge the skull or push the cap upward. Do not enlarge the face, bob or cap to fit the cropped identity image. Torso, waist, shoulders and arm geometry all follow IMAGE 1. In this frame the eyes are PARTLY/HALF OPEN, with the original low upper lids cutting across the dark irises, not wide circular eyes. Keep the source's subtle uneven eye aperture, gaze and small single curved CLOSED smile. Low IMAGE LEFT palm nearly horizontal: exact source long overlapping finger contours and separate lower thumb. High IMAGE RIGHT palm: narrow gathered fingers pointing steeply upward and separate thumb. Preserve source shoulder/frill overlap and half-body bottom truncation; show only the body/skirt portion actually visible in IMAGE 1.

IMAGE 2 is a tiny HAIR-ONLY R118 crop: only compact nape-side compression/recoil, adapted to IMAGE 1. IMAGE 3 is the BOTH-REVIEWED G12-41 identity-only crop: short ash-gray bob, face identity, two red beads. It does not prescribe current eye opening, expression, head size/position, cap scale, shading or curl length. It is deliberately a crop, never a composition target. IMAGE 5 is only the G02 SINGLE DARK CHARCOAL iris pigment sample, cropped to exclude glint/eyelid shape. Each visible iris is ONE flat charcoal fill and a tiny plain ROUND white dot, using IMAGE 1's partial aperture. No heart-shaped glints or secondary gray iris panel.

One curled lock attaches to anatomical LEFT, IMAGE RIGHT in this front view, behind the bob/nape beside the original white shoulder frill. Keep two attached red beads there. IMAGE LEFT has no bead/coil. Do not mirror head/body/hands. Lower curl continues behind original frill/shoulder where occluded; do not drag a complete tip/hole in front of the forearm for display.

REFERENCE 4 is an explicitly reviewed FIRST VISIBLE TURN of FLAT HOLLOW HAIR-CURL construction/material only. It is not an entire-curl length, taper or fixed turn-count template. Use ONE continuous opaque ash-gray HAIR RIBBON bearing a narrower muted mint stripe, winding in compact connected turns around an EMPTY interior axis, with a returning/back arc and natural taper. Preserve real negative-space air gaps between exposed turns: show actual background, or the correctly occluded underlying character. Keep the gray strip and mint stripe opaque and unlit. Do not copy this crop's particular swing direction, pitch, projection, scale or root side into every shot; adapt these to the current original head, occlusion and secondary motion reference. No closed solid cone/core, stacked oval discs, soft-serve lump, stretched large S-wave ribbon, painted white/black holes or translucent hair. All visible gray faces use the same flat pigment, including return arcs; describe depth with outlines and overlap, never dark underside panels, shine or gradients. This revised construction overrides closed/solid curls in any older identity or adjacent reference. It does not change the current original pose, expression, costume or framing.

Simple slightly uneven black PV ink and truly unlit solid pigment fills. Bob and every curl front/return face share the same ash-gray main material with a narrower muted mint material stripe. Depth uses outlines, overlap and real transparent gaps, with no lighting gradient, bright edge, dark interior panel or metallic shine. Warm peach flat skin; original black long sleeves, white cuffs and shoulder/apron frills, red chest bow/gold center, white maid cap with EXACTLY TWO black leaves. This is one complete redraw of the entire visible person, not a pasted or resized head/curl. Transparent background.
